The webhook notification flow is now clear.

The handler is `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`. It calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, which invokes `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` inside `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`. The delivery package is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`, using standard library `net/http` via `safeClient.Do(req)`.

The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks with HMAC-SHA256.

The signing headers are `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` (v1,<base64>). The signed payload is `msgID` followed by a dot, then `timestamp`, then a dot, then `body`.

No external webhook packages appear in go.mod.

Delivery is handled entirely within `internal/webhook` using the standard library `net/http`. I am checking the Standard Webhooks tests to confirm the exact dispatcher name.

I have identified the dispatcher, delivery package, and signing mechanism for memo webhooks. I am now formatting the answer.

The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. It is called from `CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go`. The delivery package is `internal/webhook` and its `PostAsync` method queues jobs to async workers. `Post` uses `net/http` `safeClient` to deliver requests. The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256.

q22.
`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`; `internal/webhook`; Standard Webhooks (HMAC-SHA256)

When a memo is created, the `CreateMemo` handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. That function delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which loads the creator’s registered webhooks via `s.Store.GetUserWebhooks`, builds a payload with activity type `memos.memo.created`, and enqueues delivery with `webhook.PostAsync`.

HTTP delivery is handled by the `internal/webhook` package (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`): `PostAsync` puts payloads on a background queue, worker goroutines call `Post`, and `Post` sends the request with the standard library `net/http` client (`safeClient.Do`).

If a signing secret is set, requests are signed using the Standard Webhooks scheme: HMAC-SHA256 over `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}`, with `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64>`) headers. Secrets prefixed with `whsec_` are base64-decoded before signing.
